arrival: Kip finds a smear of flour where the address should be.

routes.action: Let the baker handle the card
routes.reply: The baker finds a pinch of rye in the fold. At the bread cart that means the morning delivery.

routes.action: Save it for the child with the baskets
routes.reply: The child counts two handles and recognises the basket that went home empty.

arrival: Imani loosens the string. A second hand tied the last knot.

routes.action: Read it at the copying desk
routes.reply: The young copyist separates the hand that wrote from the hand that wrapped the order.

routes.action: Follow the cord to the landing
routes.reply: The runner recognises the return knot. The boat that brought it had already changed crews.

arrival: Odile has left an extra place on the cold tray.

routes.action: File the slip where the family can lift it
routes.reply: The family turns the slip over. A mark under the fold brings another name into their account.

routes.action: Warm the wrapping under the glass
routes.reply: A pale impression appears where the wrapping touched the original. The registrar saves both sheets.

arrival: Ruan sets the order below the bell window. The paper trembles twice.

routes.action: Ask the crew beneath the roof
routes.reply: They heard both sounds. Their entry identifies the second as a return from the warehouse wall.

routes.action: Give the launch crew a dry copy
routes.reply: The boat carries a copy low enough for the coxswain to see without leaving the tiller.

arrival: Ayla hears a rustle behind the watcher as the packet opens.

routes.action: Leave the keeper in the blind
routes.reply: The keeper can hear the second call from another perch. The drawing names both positions.

routes.action: Turn the count over to the walkers
routes.reply: On the moving walk the same high note travels with the recorder. The two marks stay regular.

arrival: Corra turns the docket until the clamp scar catches the light.

routes.action: Give the apprentice a cold sample
routes.reply: The apprentice repeats the fit before anyone warms the clamp. Its first mark sits outside the shop stamp.

routes.action: Reserve the next working heat
routes.reply: The night fitter tries the joint under a real load. The glowing fit leaves a narrower mark.

arrival: Mina finds a ghost letter on the inside of the wrapping.

routes.action: Keep the printer’s impression beside the leaf
routes.reply: The printer recognises the reversed shape. Her note names which side first touched the ink.

routes.action: Lend the fold to the person who reads one-handed
routes.reply: The borrower releases a corner that reveals an earlier correction. The next copy keeps the loose tab.

arrival: Sora sights down the fold of the chart. A line vanishes behind the pier.

routes.action: Send it round with the inshore pilot
routes.reply: The inshore pilot adds a familiar turn that the wharf hides from view.

routes.action: Ask the far-reef boat to bring it back
routes.reply: The boat comes back on a different tide. Its chart shows exactly where the sound dropped out.

arrival: Hari sets a chair where the late visitor can still hear.

routes.action: Run the cue from the wings
routes.reply: The caller hears the cue at once. A curtain catches the gesture before the audience sees it.

routes.action: Play the entrance from the last seat
routes.reply: The usher sees the entrance and hears the stagehand's feet first. The order goes back with both times.

arrival: Dagny empties the basket onto a length of dark cloth.

routes.action: Let the weaver bring her own basket
routes.reply: The buyer can try the order in wicker that has been used all season. It weighs more after the rain.

routes.action: Leave an empty basket underneath the pan
routes.reply: The market clerk can show each buyer what the container contributed to the total.

arrival: Omi gives the packet a cup to keep it off the wet sill.

routes.action: Wait with the crew at the lower step
routes.reply: The caller's voice reaches the last house after the gate starts moving. The crew marks the delay.

routes.action: Give the upper bank the answering cup
routes.reply: The upper caller waits for the cup to turn. A household that once stayed silent gets the first reply.

arrival: Lin sets the parcel down on the turn the printed route calls straight.

routes.action: Send a walker to the blue doorstep
routes.reply: The walker comes back with two house numbers and one worn step. The route diagram gets a hinge.

routes.action: Let the porter take the long turn
routes.reply: The porter's cart needs the width the engine model left out. The closing street receives the revised turn.

arrival: Wren puts the family key beside the listening index.

routes.action: Give the key to the speaker’s household
routes.reply: The family provides a time when a listener can ask to hear the passage. The original stays on their shelf.

routes.action: Leave a listening appointment in the index
routes.reply: Another listener finds the date and the name of the person who can choose what plays.

arrival: Ivo shades the smallest row while the crate waits beside the jetty.

routes.action: Let the gardener adjust the shade
routes.reply: The gardener moves just the edge of the cloth. The smallest row changes before the rest of the model.

routes.action: Hand the working model to the returning carrier
routes.reply: The carrier tries it on the sloping deck. A loose tree rolls into the plot that the drawing omitted.

arrival: Hale turns the second receiver toward the witness rail.

routes.action: Seat the witness beside the receiver
routes.reply: The witness can stop the reel at the part their neighbour remembers. The pause enters the hearing.

routes.action: Give the visitors the two listening slips
routes.reply: Each visitor compares both times at their own pace. Someone carries the earlier slip to the second sitting.
